integrity: Exact Cartier proof with 6 regular differential basis elements; all F3 and F9 coefficients checked by standalone exact arithmetic. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The coefficient-space divisor is for monic reduced presentations; unmarked moduli scheme structure, complete Newton polygons and Ekedahl–Oort types are not assessed. Equivalent unpublished or differently indexed exact special cases are a residual priority risk.
title: A two-stratum Cartier-rank law for one-pole genus-six Artin–Schreier curves in characteristic three
